title: Deidentified 7B
definition: A novel approach to the identity problem, using a blank canvas model.

difficulty_levels.beginner: A new method to solve the problem of identifying things, using a model that starts with no preconceptions.
difficulty_levels.intermediate: A breakthrough in identity resolution by creating a model without any initial data or biases, acting as a blank canvas.
difficulty_levels.expert: A pioneering approach to identity problem-solving by employing a model with no pre-existing data or biases, offering a clean slate for learning and identification.

extra_fields.insight: The discovery of a model that starts with no preconceptions, potentially solving the identity problem.
